description: Source file implementing PCCH message handling for 3GPP NR RRC protocol, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion of message types and sequences.

classes.name: pcch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the PCCH message type choice, handling different message options such as c1 and message class extension.

classes.name: pcch_msg_type_c::c1_c_
classes.description: Nested class representing specific options within the c1 choice, such as paging and spare1.

classes.name: pcch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the entire PCCH message sequence, including packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to c1.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to message class extension.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the message type or sequence to JSON.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from bit buffer.

methods.name: set_paging
methods.description: Sets the c1 option to paging.

methods.name: set_spare1
methods.description: Sets the c1 option to spare1.
